title: Install
heading: Put “Pazarko” on your phone
intro: Opens with one tap from your home screen, full screen — like a real app.
notNow: Not now — continue in the browser
installed: Done! Open “Pazarko” from your phone's home screen.
bannerSub: Opens with one tap, full screen
iosStep1: Tap Share in Safari (bottom centre or in the ⋯ menu)
iosStep2: Choose “Add to Home Screen” and then “Add”
iosNote: Apple doesn't let websites install themselves — that's why it takes these two steps. Works only in Safari.
androidStep1: Open the browser menu ⋮ (top or bottom right)
androidStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
